title: Customer cards: one picture of the fruit for each piece
problem: A customer's wants were drawn as one picture of the fruit followed by a dot for each piece. The picture reads as a piece, so two pieces looked like three (one picture and two dots). Found on the way: on the new Home, a first customer's card opened whole stayed inside the mode card's box after a tab change or swipe, and the host's shoes showed over it.
scope: The table's customer tickets, the customer card opened whole and the larger customer card on the table: a picture of the fruit for each piece, no dots and no lone picture in front
A ticket too narrow for its pictures shows one picture and "×3", as it showed a number before
Home: a card opened whole covers the screen after a tab change or swipe, and covers the host
exclusions: Standing orders keep their dots (they ask for more pieces)
No change to what any customer wants or pays: rules, balance and saves untouched
Not published: the preview and the live game change only on the owner's word
The printed deck draws the same customer card, so a new print would show the pictures too; nothing is reprinted by this plan

acceptance.evidence: records OK, palette, lint, types, 1440 passed in 139 files, build OK
Not run locally for this change; CI on the release pull request runs it

acceptance.text: In the browser at 390x844: a ticket and a whole card show one picture per piece; the whole card fills the screen after a tab change
